project_title: Emebet Bijigdu Mode: The Generous Governor

character_ref.name: Emebet Bijigdu Mode
character_ref.role: Governor of Guduru Malole Warada, Wellega Awraja
character_ref.description: Dignified Ethiopian woman governor seated upright on a sturdy mule adorned with ornate silver chains, wearing a traditional ceremonial cloak (Kaba), a full ammunition belt (Zinar), and her personal pistol at her waist, with a commanding yet warm expression, centered in frame.

style_block: Cinematic documentary film still, warm natural highland daylight in Wellega Awraja, rich earthy tones, subtle film grain, authentic historic rural-town street atmosphere, crisp focus, no text or watermarks in image.

shots.reason: Establish Wellega Awraja, Guduru Malole Warada, Emebet Bijigdu Mode on her silver-chained mule, and her ten-guard formation.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a historic highland town road in Guduru Malole Warada, Wellega Awraja; Emebet Bijigdu Mode riding a mule adorned with silver chains, wearing a traditional ceremonial cloak (Kaba), ammunition belt (Zinar), and pistol; two guards ahead, two behind, three on her left, and three on her right carrying older Kalashnikov rifles.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle forward dolly along the dusty highland town road; guards walk steadily with subtle fabric movement.
shots.narration_am: በወለጋ አውራጃ ጉዱሩ ማሎሌ ወረዳ እመቤት ቢጅግዱ ሞዴ የተከበሩ አስተዳዳሪ ነበሩ።
shots.subtitles_en: In Wellega Awraja, Guduru Malole Warada, Emebet Bijigdu Mode was a revered governor.

shots.reason: Introduce Emebet Bijigdu Mode's calm authority, ceremonial Kaba, Zinar, pistol, and silver-chained mule.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of Emebet Bijigdu Mode seated upright and calm on her mule in the center of the frame, wearing a traditional ceremonial Kaba cloak, a full Zinar ammunition belt, and her pistol, with gleaming silver chains draped along the mule's tack in warm afternoon light.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle gentle head turn and mule rhythmic step with delicate sway of silver chains; camera holds steady with slight push-in.
shots.narration_am: ካባ ደርበው፣ ዝናር ታጥቀውና ሽጉጣቸውን ይዘው በክብር ይወጡ ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: Draped in a ceremonial Kaba, belted with a Zinar and her pistol, she rode forth in dignity.

shots.reason: Show the front and flank guard arrangement clearly without visual clutter.
shots.image_prompt: Medium wide view of Emebet Bijigdu Mode in her Kaba and Zinar on her silver-chained mule, with two guards ahead leading the way and three guards walking along her left flank with older Kalashnikov rifles.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow lateral track keeping Emebet Bijigdu Mode centered; footsteps and gentle breeze in clothing.
shots.narration_am: ከፊት ሁለት፣ ከኋላ ሁለት፣ በግራና በቀኝ ሶስት ሶስት ጠባቂዎች በአሮጌ ክላሽንኮቭ ያጅቧቸዋል።
shots.subtitles_en: Two guards ahead, two behind, and three on each flank escorted her with older Kalashnikovs.

shots.reason: Ground the era and texture through authentic details of the silver chains, Zinar belt, and vintage escort rifles.
shots.image_prompt: Close medium detail shot of ornate silver chains chiming against the mule's leather harness beside a traditional Zinar ammunition belt and a guard's vintage rifle strap on a packed earth road.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across the swaying silver chains and dust on the path; subtle rhythmic motion.
shots.narration_am: የዝናሩና የመሳሪያው ግርማ ለፍርሃት ሳይሆን ለህዝብ ሰላምና ስርዓት ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: The Zinar and escort arms stood not for fear, but for civic peace and order.

shots.reason: Show townspeople recognizing the melodic chime of her mule's silver chains as she passes through town.
shots.image_prompt: Townspeople standing along both sides of a sunlit street in Guduru Malole turning happily as Emebet Bijigdu Mode passes on her silver-chained mule surrounded by her guards.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle camera pan toward smiling onlookers; people recognize the silver chain chimes, wave, and greet her warmly.
shots.narration_am: የበቅሎዋ የብር ሰንሰለት ዜማ ሲሰማ ህዝቡ እመቤት ቢጅግዱ ማለፋቸውን አውቆ በደስታ ይቀበላቸዋል።
shots.subtitles_en: Hearing the melody of her mule's silver chains, townspeople knew Emebet Bijigdu was passing and greeted her gladly.

shots.reason: Capture the communal chant and warmth of the crowd.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of local residents in traditional highland attire chanting together with open, joyful faces along the street edge during a daytime procession.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle handheld feel with gentle movement as residents chant in unison.
shots.narration_am: ለጋስነታቸውን በማስታወስ ህዝቡ በአንድነት እየተቀባበለ በልብ ምስጋና ያወድሳቸዋል።
shots.subtitles_en: Remembering her generosity, the people chanted together in heartfelt praise.

shots.reason: Show Emebet Bijigdu Mode's quiet, approachable humility toward her people.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of Emebet Bijigdu Mode in her ceremonial Kaba on her mule, gentle acknowledging nod and warm, welcoming expression as she listens to the townspeople.
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push-in and a gentle nod; soft natural light on her face.
shots.narration_am: እርሳቸውም በትህትና ይመልሳሉ፤ ችግር የገጠመው ሁሉ ያለ ፍርሃት ወደ እርሳቸው ይቀርብ ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: She answered with humility; anyone facing hardship could approach her freely without fear.

shots.reason: Illustrate her concrete generosity: granting a cow, an ox, and Xegera currency to rebuild livelihoods.
shots.image_prompt: Wide sunlit courtyard and town edge scene in Guduru Malole where grateful townspeople lead a healthy cow and an ox gifted to restart their livelihood while Emebet Bijigdu Mode looks on warmly.
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth slow wide glide as townsfolk lead the cow and ox peacefully along the sunlit path.
shots.narration_am: ኑሯቸውን እንዲያቀኑ አንድ ላምና አንድ በሬ፣ ከዚያም የጠገራ ብር ሰጥተው ያቋቁሟቸው ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: To rebuild their lives, she gifted them one cow and one ox to multiply, along with Xegera silver currency.

shots.reason: Reinforce why Emebet Bijigdu Mode endured in memory—authority paired with restorative generosity.
shots.image_prompt: Emebet Bijigdu Mode seated proudly on her silver-chained mule in her Kaba, Zinar, and pistol, looking ahead along the sunlit road with her escort formation around her.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle steady forward movement; warm light shifting slightly across the scene.
shots.narration_am: ስማቸው በታሪክ የቀረው በስልጣን ብቻ ሳይሆን በቸርነትና ህዝብን በማንሳት ስለተለዩ ነው።
shots.subtitles_en: Her name endured not from authority alone, but from lifting her people through generosity.

shots.reason: Close the narrative arc in Guduru Malole cleanly before the end card.
shots.image_prompt: Emebet Bijigdu Mode on her silver-chained mule and her escort continuing down the sunlit road of Guduru Malole Warada toward the highland horizon, warm golden-hour atmosphere.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow receding wide shot leading smoothly into a fade out.
shots.narration_am: የእመቤት ቢጅግዱ ሞዴ ታሪክ ለትውልድ የሚተላለፍ የክብርና የልግስና ትዝታ ነው።
shots.subtitles_en: The story of Emebet Bijigdu Mode remains a legacy of honor and generosity passed down.
